messages:
Maya Patel: FYI customer (ACME) opened a ticket — they see repeated 403s when hitting our text-generation endpoint. They pasted a curl that shows "invalid_api_key" in the UI, but the raw response body has a different hint. Can someone take a look?

Samir Chen: putting the request they sent into the thread. Repro steps from customer: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXXXX' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response body: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "access_denied",
    "message": "Access denied: plan limit",
    "code": "PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED",
    "metadata": {"required_plan":"dedicated","current_plan":"starter"}
  }
}
```
HTTP status: 403

Samir Chen: so note the UI around their integration is showing "Invalid API key" because the console maps 403 -> generic auth modal. But backend clearly returned PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED.

Maya Patel: customer-facing message said "Your key is invalid or expired" which is misleading. They paused rollout because they think it's an SSO issue.

Priya Gomez: tagging billing. @Priya Gomez can you confirm whether ACME is on Starter and whether that endpoint/model is gated to higher tiers?

Priya Gomez: checked ACME account (internal id: acct_78f). They are on Starter. redwood-large is flagged for Dedicated and above due to GPU cost. This looks like expected gating. I can see the authorization call path sets error code PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED.

Alex Ruiz: quick note from infra: our entitlement service returns an enum error and our edge layer maps it to 403 with X-Auth-Problem header for diagnostics. The edge also adds a user-facing message based on feature flag `ui-auth-mapping:v2`. That flag currently maps most 403s to "Authentication failed" for older SDKs.

Maya Patel: can we immediately change the UI mapping for this customer so they get a clearer message? They are blocked in production.

Samir Chen: temporary mitigation: we can add the raw error hint in the API response logging for support tool so customer gets clearer text in the ticket. For a short-term customer reply I can paste the backend body and explain it's a billing plan mismatch.

Priya Gomez: I can also send a one-off invite to handle an upgrade or provide a trial add-on. If they want to continue with redwood-large we can enable a 14-day trial for Dedicated.

Alex Ruiz: longer-term: we should change the edge layer mapping so that when entitlement service sets code PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED we expose a 403 body with message "Plan does not allow model: upgrade required" and add header `X-Entitlement-Code: PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED`. Also add a distinct error code (e.g., 402-like semantic) in SDKs so it's not mistaken for auth.

Maya Patel: customer-facing copy suggestion: "Your API key is valid, but your plan doesn't include access to the requested model or feature. Please upgrade or request a trial."

Samir Chen: dev note: smaller change to edge: map PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED -> attach header `X-Entitlement` and keep 403 for now. I'll open a PR to change the mapping and include unit tests.

Samir Chen: linking to quick log snippet from prod showing header we get from entitlement service: 
```
ENTITLEMENT_RESP: { code: 'PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED', allowed: false, required_plan: 'dedicated' }
EDGE_ADDED_HEADERS: { 'x-entitlement-code': 'PLAN_TIER_RESTRICTED' }
```

Priya Gomez: created billing action item: BLG-2345 — reach out to ACME to offer trial + mark their account for follow-up.

Maya Patel: drafting reply to customer now. Will include explicit instructions to upgrade and attach a temporary trial link.

Alex Ruiz: infra action item: INF-6789 — change ui-auth-mapping flagged behavior, ensure SDKs surface `error.code` from body rather than showing generic "invalid key" for 403s.

Maya Patel: sending reply to customer: "Thanks — your API key is valid. The 403 is due to your plan not covering that model. We can enable a trial to unblock you; would you like us to enable a 14-day trial for redwood-large?" :thumbsup:

Samir Chen: PR up: https://git.internal.redwood/p/infra/edge/+/4321 — small mapping change + tests.

Priya Gomez: emailed ACME on BLG-2345 thread offering trial, cc'd Maya.

Maya Patel: closing the support ticket after customer confirmed trial accepted. Leaving thread open for the infra/billing follow-ups.

infra-bot: INF-6789 created and assigned to @Alex Ruiz (due 2026-01-12).

Priya Gomez: follow-up note for docs: we should add a troubleshooting section in API errors doc that distinguishes auth 401/403 vs entitlement 403 and include sample responses and suggested user copy. I'll take ownership.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone — smooth handoff.
